items.title: Former Andhra Pradesh Deputy CM Alla Nani dies of cardiac arrest at 56
items.summary: Former Andhra Pradesh deputy chief minister and YSRCP leader Alla Kali Krishna Srinivas, popularly known as Alla Nani, died of a cardiac arrest in Visakhapatnam on Tuesday, September 15. He was 56. Alla Nani, who served as Health and Medical Education Minister in the YS Jagan Mohan Reddy government, was a three-time MLA from the Eluru Assembly constituency. His mortal remains were taken to his native Eluru by road, where family members, supporters and followers paid their last respects. Alla Nani reportedly went for a morning walk and returned home before complaining of uneasiness. He was rushed to a hospital after suffering a cardiac arrest but died during treatment. His body will be cremated in Eluru on Wednesday, September 16. He is survived by his wife Alla Rekha and two sons, Alla Kalikrishna Manichandra and Alla Ashish. Born on December 30, 1969, in Eluru in the erstwhile West Godavari district, Alla Nani was the son of Alla Suryachandra Rao and Nagamani. He completed his schooling at KP High School in Eluru in 1985 and his Intermediate education at Sir CR Reddy College in 1988. He later enrolled for a BA at Andhra University but discontinued his studies. Alla Nani contested

items.title: 8rney introduces Agentic Legal AI Workspace for lawyers, law firms and law students
items.summary: Agentic Legal AI platform 8rney is built with a focus on bringing research, drafting, document work and matter management into one place. The company is co-founded by Aryaman Singh , an alumnus of RGNUL, Patiala, and Abhimanyu Dhull , a second-time founder who has previously founded Estavel AI (now BlackcoatAI), a Legal AI venture. 8rney enters the market with a simple product idea and belief that next phase of legal AI is shaped by agents that can be trusted with real work. The company's longer-term vision is for every lawyer to work alongside their own team of agents. These agents would prepare the morning brief and cause list before court, keep track of matters and deadlines across a team, prioritise and draft what comes out of the day's hearings, and turn changes agreed in a meeting into a revised draft. For a law firm, the result is an AI-native practice running alongside its lawyers. Every lawyer has agents producing finished work, and lawyers spend their time on judgement, strategy and final review. 8rney places approval controls around any action that may send, file or overwrite work. In the judgment delivered on September 11, a division bench of Justices Anu Sivaraman and Venkatesh Naik T also imposed a cost of ₹2,000 on advocate Pankaj Kaushik for his misconduct. The Court observed the advocate lacked genuine remorse and tried to justify his actions while continuing to make scurrilous, scandalous and baseless statements against the judiciary. "His conduct can only be termed as deliberate and adamant and reveals complete apathy towards social, moral and judicial codes of conduct. items.title: Andhra: Bag containing gelatin sticks, detonators recovered from bus in Vijayawada
items.summary: A bag containing explosives was found on a bus at the Pandit Nehru Bus Station (PNBS) in Vijayawada in the early hours of Tuesday, September 15. The unattended luggage was noticed by a passenger, Asif Ali from Uttar Pradesh. He alerted and handed the bag over to the Krishnalanka police. Officials have recovered 46 gelatin sticks and 50 detonators from the bag. Preliminary investigation revealed that the luggage had been left on a bus that had travelled from Narasaraopet in Palnadu district, 97 kilometers away to Vijayawada. The South Zone police of the NTR district commissionerate have launched an investigation to identify and locate the person who left the explosive substance on the bus. Special teams have been formed for the purpose, while a bomb detection squad and sniffer dog were deployed as part of the search. Deputy Commissioner of Police Krishna Kanth Patil said the police were examining the incident from all possible angles and were confident of tracing the owner of the bag. The Krishnalanka police have registered a case under the Explosives Act and relevant provisions of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), 2023. items.title: CJP Protests: Supreme Court refuses to reconstitute panel probing violence
items.summary: The Supreme Court recently refused to reconstitute the High-Powered Enquiry Committee (HPEC) which is examining the violence that broke out during the July Cockroach Janata Party (CJP) student protests at Jantar Mantar. A Bench of Chief Justice of India Surya Kant and Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana declined an application filed by certain parties to reconstitute the HPEC noting that their objections to the panel were premature. " We are constrained to observe, with some measure of disquiet, that aspersions have been cast upon the HPEC in a manner that is both premature and precipitate ", the Court said in its order. The Court said the request was based on mere conjecture as the HPEC has only just begun its enquiry. " It must be understood by one and all that the HPEC has been constituted to assist this Court with the highest standards of fairness and transparency and with a dispassionate approach. The HPEC is not created to espouse the causes of one or the other party before us ," the Bench said.
